```text
# #1664: Patch: XP track bars fill after every game, each level reached revealed with its rewards
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

Part of #1651 (brief §4). It is built on the bars part's `FillBar` and `RewardReveal`, the game-economy part's answers and the pill part's wallet store, and is blocked by all three.

### The answers (from the game-economy part)
`GameEconomy = { jlore, xp, jloreCapped, tracks: [{ setId, before: TrackPoint, after: TrackPoint, levels: [{ level, rewards: { jlore, setPacks, cardTokens } }] }], quests: [{ questId, title, jlore, xp }] }`, with `TrackPoint = { level, xp, levelXp: number | null, xpToNext: number | null }`. It arrives in three places:
- as `economy` on the match socket's `view` frame (beside `jloreCapped`, `game/net.ts` ~l.298–335), once the result is written;
- the same on the co-op frame (`duos/socket.ts` ~l.80);
- as `tracks` and `quests` on the paid practice claim (`net/practice.ts` ~l.34).
Mirror the types in `apps/web/src/economy/xp.ts`.

### Do
- **`apps/web/src/economy/XpReveal.tsx`.** For each track gain, a FillBar from `before` (`levelXp − xpToNext` of `levelXp`) to `after`, with `fills` the levels reached.
  - At each fill the level number pops and RewardReveal shows that level's rewards one by one (Jlore, set packs, card tokens, in `collection/collection.ts::rewardWords`' words), with the sting.
  - Several levels chain; past the last level the bar shows full.
  - The quests the game completed are listed with their Jlore and XP. Quests complete only inside a game's payout (§14.9), so this is where a completion shows; `routes/QuestsPanel.tsx` needs no change.
  - Reduce motion shows the end state and every reward at once.
  - The client computes no curve: every number is the answer's.
- **Where it shows.** At the end of a ladder, unranked or Conquest game (`routes/match.tsx`, by the `Daily Jlore reached` line ~l.440), of a co-op game (`duos/DuosBoard.tsx` ~l.215), and of a paid practice game (`practice/PracticeResult.tsx`, fed through `routes/practice.tsx` ~l.1038–1044 and `practice/earning.ts`).
- **The pill.** When a game's `economy` arrives, and after a paid practice claim, call `announceWallet()` (`economy/wallet.ts`, the pill part) so the pill reads the wallet again.
- **The tracks panel.** In `collection/TracksPanel.tsx` the bare `<progress>` becomes a FillBar (no `from`) with the same `max` and `value`, keeping every test id; FillBar keeps a `<progress>`, which e2e spec 45 reads.

### Files
`apps/web/src/economy/xp.ts`, `economy/XpReveal.tsx`, `economy/xp.css`, `economy/XpReveal.test.tsx`, `collection/TracksPanel.test.tsx` (new); `game/net.ts` and `game/net.test.ts`, `duos/socket.ts`, `duos/DuosBoard.tsx`, `routes/match.tsx` (and `routes/match.test.tsx` for a case), `net/practice.ts`, `practice/earning.ts`, `practice/PracticeResult.tsx`, `routes/practice.tsx` (and `routes/practice.test.tsx` for a case), `collection/TracksPanel.tsx`.
Not here: `economy/FillBar.tsx` and the bars part's other files, `economy/wallet.ts`, `routes/collection.tsx` and `collection/collection.test.tsx` (the Collection part).

### Done when
- `economy/XpReveal.test.tsx`: a track going from before to after a game with a level-up fills, pops the level and reveals the server's rewards; two levels chain in order; a completed quest is listed; reduced motion shows the end state and every reward at once.
- A socket parse test: `economy` is read for the seat, and a frame without it leaves none.
- A practice test: the paid answer's tracks reach the result.
- `collection/TracksPanel.test.tsx`: the bar shows `levelXp − xpToNext` of `levelXp`, with its test ids.
Run `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/economy/XpReveal.test.tsx src/collection/TracksPanel.test.tsx src/game/net.test.ts src/routes/practice.test.tsx src/routes/match.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`.

**Fullsend.** A part of #1651: it lands on `bot/issue-1651` with no checks or review of its own, beside the other parts. Change only the files named here. A check red only because a sibling part has not landed yet is expected. Leave to the reconcile the `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` entry of each new `t()` string, `apps/web/README.md`, and every e2e spec. Keep every existing test id.

Blocked by #1658, #1657, #1659.

Its build lands on `bot/issue-1651`, not `main` (fullsend).

Part of #1651, split by Night bot (`opus`, [run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/39819773251)).
```
